instruction: Export the Personal Address Book from Thunderbird to contacts.csv on the Desktop, then open it with LibreOffice Calc and save it as contacts.xlsx on the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting 30 contacts (plus header = 31 rows) to CSV and converting to XLSX. Evaluator checks: (1) CSV exists [0.25], (2) XLSX exists [0.25], (3) CSV has 31 rows [0.25], (4) XLSX has 31 rows [0.25]. Verified: contacts_gold.csv has 61 lines but actual data rows including header is 31 (30 contacts + header).
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.25 per check: CSV exists, XLSX exists, CSV rows=31, XLSX rows=31
